decisions.reason: As a newly launched core automation product with no visible evidence of underperformance yet, it is likely to be kept while the firm learns about market acceptance and uses its slack to support the rollout.

Although it overlaps functionally with the combined robot and may face closer comparison against internal aspirations, the lack of a clear shortfall still makes continued market presence more likely than withdrawal.

This product appears complementary to the broader robotic handling line, and a mature German machinery firm would usually allow more time before dropping such a specialized product absent clear failure signals.

As with the automatic de-shuttering robot, overlap with the combined solution raises some rationalization risk, but without clear evidence of results below aspiration the firm would more likely retain it for another year.
